modern: Try how the life of the good man suits you, the life of one who is satisfied with his share of the whole, and satisfied with his own just acts and kindly disposition.
original: Try how the life of the good man suits thee, the life of him who is satisfied with his portion out of the whole, and satisfied with his own just acts and benevolent disposition.

notification_original: Try how the life of the good man suits thee, the life of him who is satisfied with his portion out of the whole, and satisfied with his own just acts and benevolent disposition.

explained.summary: Try out the life of a good person and see how it suits you: someone content with their share of what the world hands out, and satisfied with acting fairly and being kind. Marcus frames it as an experiment, as though goodness is something you test by living it.
explained.today: For one week, take what comes at work without complaint, do your bit honestly and be kind to whoever’s in front of you. Then notice whether you feel worse, or a good deal lighter.
